title: Fixed Size Array - Creation
description:
You've used arrays before, but now we're making our own! Arrays are just contiguous blocks of memory storing the same datatype, which allows for O(1) (**STUPID FAST**) Read and writes.


---
## Assignment:
Right now, if you look at our class, it is _very_ empty, with just a length (int), and data (T*). Make the constructor, which should take a `int` (size), defaulting to 1 if < 1, and A: Assign length to size and B: Allocate size' T's into data.
